messages.subject: 2 part qtl model question
parts:
Dear Karl Broman,


I have a doubt about my understanding of Rqtl manual for the choice to make between TRUE or FALSE for the argument upper for a two part model in the function Scanone.
So when I choose upper=FALSE, it is for a data that has a spike at 0 (if my phenotype goes from 0 to 10 for example) and if I choose upper=TRUE, it will take a spike at 10 is that right?


Thank you for you help,

Ningning ZHOU

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] 2 part qtl model question
parts:
In the help file for scanone, it's explained as follows:

upper    Used only for the two-part model; if true, the "undefined"
phenotype is the maximum
         observed phenotype; otherwise, it is the smallest observed
phenotype.

karl
